title: Boundary-layer L^2 estimate for W^{1,2}(B)
statement: For every n >= 1 there is C >= 0 (C = 2^{n+3} works) with the following property. For all f, g with IsW12WithGradient f g B (B the open unit ball of R^n) and every r in (0,1): int_{B \ B_r} |f|^2 <= C sqrt(1-r) (int_B |f|^2 + int_B |g|^2), where B_r := ball(0,r) and all integrals are lintegrals of squared extended norms.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1 \ ball 0 r, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * Real.sqrt (1 - r)) * ((∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f x‖ₑ ^ 2) + ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2)
